notes: v9 (estimated-window fallback for expired cycles, founder feedback 2026-08-10): 12 records whose concrete application_window had a real but now-PAST close_date (Carlsberg GTP 2026, AB InBev Dreamship 2026, Home Credit Home Racer 2026, Shopee & Monee GDP, Nestlé #SparkTheNext 2026, MoMo Talent 2026, Viettel Future Changemakers, UOB Vietnam MA, Prudential The Strivers 2025, Deloitte Passport FY26, EY Tax Internship 2027, Abbott Internship 2025) were converted from concrete estimated:false dates to the SAME estimated-annual-window pattern already used by Unilever/L'Oréal/Suntory PepsiCo: open_date/close_date set back to null, open_text/close_text reworded as ~DD/MM 'estimated' referencing the real researched cycle, and estimated_open_month/estimated_open_day added so the app projects the next likely opening date instead of dead-ending on 'Closed' with no forward guidance. This directly addresses founder feedback that an annual program's last real cycle should be shifted forward a year, exactly like the app already does for the 3 pattern-setting verified programs. rounds_detail periods on these 12 records were also generalized from hard year-tagged dates to '~Month (estimated)' style to match. central-retail-ma-2026 and techcombank-futuregen-2027 were left untouched since their windows are still genuinely upcoming (not yet closed) as of 2026-08-10. Mirrored in lib/programTimelines.ts. v8 (founder-directed web research ingestion, 2026-08-09): filled application_window / rounds_detail / program_url / functions for 16 previously coming_soon programs (Carlsberg GTP 2026, Central Retail MA 2026, AB InBev Dreamship 2026, Home Credit Home Racer 2026, Shopee & Monee GDP, Nestlé #SparkTheNext 2026, MoMo Talent 2026, Viettel Future Changemakers, UOB Vietnam MA, Prudential The Strivers 2025, Expeditors MT, PropertyGuru Prodi-G 2025, P&G LEAD GEN 2026, Deloitte Passport FY26, EY Tax Internship 2027, Abbott Internship 2025) plus a functions list for Techcombank Future Gen 2027 — per explicit founder instruction (2026-08-09) authorizing the agent to web-research and self-fill the format, defaulting month-only opens to day 01. Source: official company career pages / recruiter LinkedIn-and-press posts found via web search — NOT founder-pasted data. All details_status values are intentionally left 'coming_soon' (including Techcombank) since no explicit founder confirmation of current-cycle verification was given in this pass. Several 2025/2026-labelled cycles have already closed as of today (2026-08-09); their dates are preserved as the historical record of that named cohort and the app's countdown correctly renders them as closed. Where NO current-cycle date or functions list could be confirmed from public sources, the field is left absent — real remaining gaps: central-retail-ma-2026 functions, uob-vietnam-ma functions, expeditors-mt dates/rounds/functions, propertyguru-prodig-2025 dates, pg-leadgen-2026 dates. Mirrored in lib/programTimelines.ts. v7 (estimated-open anchor — founder directive 2026-08-09): estimated application_window records now carry estimated_open_month/estimated_open_day; the app anchors month-only estimated open windows to a concrete display date defaulting to DAY 01 of that month ('Expected to open 01/12 — estimated') plus a prep-runway day count, so candidates have a real date to prepare toward. Display-only: open_date/close_date STILL stay null until founder-verified and the 'X days left' countdown still only runs off close_date. Mirrored in lib/programTimelines.ts — keep BOTH in sync. v6 (program timeline display): verified records now carry structured application_window (open_date/close_date stay NULL until the founder verifies concrete current-cycle dates — the app's 'X days left' countdown only ever runs off close_date; open_text/close_text hold the estimated windows already stated in the record, always labelled 'estimated') and rounds_detail (round names + estimated periods, straight from the verified rounds/timeline text). Mirrored client-side in lib/programTimelines.ts — keep BOTH in sync when verifying new timeline data. Never invent dates: only founder-verified data lands in these fields. v5 (v1.4 grounding fix): sector_taxonomy added — the founder-approved sector buckets the scoring engine uses as a HARD FILTER (a candidate's chosen sector removes every off-sector program from ranking; FMCG splits into cosmetics/personal-care vs food & beverage; multi-sector companies like Unilever sit in every bucket they genuinely play in, and a company NEVER appears for a sector it has no presence in). v4: Shopee & Monee GDP is categorized as pure e-commerce / digital services (no consumer-brands/FMCG/beauty linkage). FMCG programs carry fmcg_subverticals so FMCG is never treated as one monolithic category (food & dairy / beverages / beauty & personal care / household & home care / health & nutrition).
